name: scout
description: Research and search. research-orchestrator routes a query to five scout agents (github / hf / web / docs / paper) in parallel and synthesis-scout dedups, trust-ranks, and writes the report (exa MCP first, WebSearch fallback, brightdata tier-3, insane-search tier-4). ask and generate-llmstxt query a GitHub repository through the DeepWiki MCP. paper-search searches and downloads papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and five more sources through the bundled paper-search MCP server (.mcp.json, Docker). Non-code/ML topics go to the sibling /deep-research.
